blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The CLARKE building and road damage assessment AI classifier was incorporated into the Catastrophic Unmanned Remote Sensing Exercise (CURSE) 2026, which trained 23 small uncrewed aerial systems (sUAS) teams from state and local agencies and non-governmental organizations in Florida and Missouri on how to collect imagery for an incident command Remote Sensing Cell. Although CLARKE has been operationally deployed to two hurricanes (Debby and Helene), CURSE'26 presented an opportunity to evaluate the machine learning model with a larger set of never-before-seen orthomosaics. The results show that building and road damage assessment together ran in 3.5 minutes on average, and that building damage assessment achieved a Micro F1 of 0.834 with no manual adjustments to correct spatial misalignment and delivered that performance in both Florida and Missouri, demonstrating good geographic transfer. It also showed that road damage assessment performed poorly due to sensitivity to misalignment between road maps and the images, and to lighting and environmental conditions in an urban setting. The analysis of CURSE'26 presents five other findings of value to the sUAS community: that the use of sUAS and machine learning is now operationally normalized and accepted, sUAS teams in the field can improve classification accuracy by timing their flights, exercises are good operational tests but their value for evaluating learning models is less clear, edge computing is needed to overcome the wireless upload barrier, and the application of sUAS and AI to disaster response has ethical and legal ramifications for pilots and data managers.
blocks.zh: CLARKE的建筑和道路损坏评估AI分类器被纳入了2026年灾难无人遥感演习(CURSE),该演习对来自佛罗里达州和地方机构和非政府组织的23个小型无人驾驶航空系统小组进行了关于如何为事件指挥遥感小组收集图像的培训。 虽然CLARKE已经实际部署在了两场飓风(德比和海伦)上,但CURSE'26提供了一个机会,用更大的一套永不见光的正交形来评价机器学习模型. 结果显示,建筑和道路损坏评估平均在3.5分钟内进行,建筑损坏评估实现了0.834的Micro F1,没有进行人工调整来纠正空间错位,并在佛罗里达州和密苏里州都实现了这一性能,显示出良好的地理学转移. 评估还显示,道路损坏评估表现不佳,原因是对路线图和图像之间不一致的敏感性以及城市环境中的照明和环境条件。 对CURSE'26的分析提出了对SUAS社区有价值的其他5个结论:SUAS和机器学习的使用现已在业务上正常化并被接受,SUAS在外地的团队可以通过飞行时间提高分类准确性,练习是良好的操作测试,但其评价学习模型的价值并不明确,需要边际计算来克服无线上传障碍,SUAS和AI在救灾中的应用对飞行员和数据管理人员具有伦理和法律影响.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
On May 19, 2026, Florida State University’s Emergency Management and Homeland Security (EMHS) program conducted the Catastrophic Unmanned Remote Sensing Exercise (CURSE) 2026. The full-scale exercise
was designed to evaluate the use of small uncrewed aerial systems (sUAS) and remote sensing workflows during a catastrophic incident.
The 20 participating agencies and non-governmental organizations in Florida and Missouri operated from their home jurisdictions, flying sUAS to collect and process imagery locally, then transmitting the imagery and derived products to a centralized Remote Sensing Cell (RSC) located in Tallahassee (Fig. 1 ). The RSC integrated the data from the sUAS into a common operating picture and distributed products to stakeholders, completing the sUAS data-to-decision process as would be done during an actual disaster.
blocks.zh:
2026年5月19日,佛罗里达州立大学的应急管理和国土安全(EMHS)计划进行了2026年灾难无人遥感演习(CURSE). 全面演习
目的是评估小型无人驾驶航空系统和遥感工作流程在灾难性事件中的使用情况。
佛罗里达州和密苏里州的20个参与机构和非政府组织从其本国管辖区域运作,飞越SUAS,在当地收集和处理图像,然后将图像和衍生产品传送给位于塔拉哈西(图1)的中央遥感小组。 登记册系统控制中心将SUAS数据纳入共同操作图,并向利益攸关方分发产品,完成SUAS数据与决策程序,如同在实际灾害中所做的那样。

blocks.en:
An integral part of the CURSE sUAS data-to-decision process was
CLARKE (Computer vision and Learning for Analysis of Roads and Key Edifices), an automatic building and road damage assessment classifier.
CLARKE had been deployed during the operational responses to Hurricanes Debby and Helene in 2024 [ 1 , 2 ] and was included in CURSE’26 as the “new normal” for producing initial damage assessment reports within minutes.
CLARKE provides automated building and road damage assessment for sUAS-acquired orthomosaics. Building damage assessment is labeled according to the commonly used Joint Damage Scale (JDS) [ 3 ] , while road damage uses a novel labeling schema as there are no existing standards. The building damage assessment component uses an encoder-decoder architecture consisting of a fine-tuned Vision Transformer [ 4 ] encoder and a UperNet [ 5 ] decoder, and the road damage assessment component uses an Attention U-Net architecture [ 6 ] trained on the CRASAR-U-DROIDs dataset [ 7 ] . This dataset ensures models have high operational fidelity because it contains over 67 gigapixels of imagery collected directly by responding agencies across 10 federally declared disasters.
blocks.zh:
CURSE SUAS数据对决定过程的一个组成部分是:
CLARKE(计算机视觉和学习,分析道路和关键通道),自动建筑和道路损坏评估分类器.
CLARKE在2024年对Debby和Helene飓风的业务反应中已经部署,并被列入CURSE ' 26,作为在几分钟内编写初步损害评估报告的 " 新常态 " 。
CLARKE为SUAS获得的矫形学提供自动化建筑和道路损坏评估. 建筑损坏评估按照常用的联合损坏等级表(JDS)[3]进行标签,而道路损坏则使用新的标记方案,因为没有现行标准。 建筑损毁评估部分采用编码器-解码器架构,包括一个微调的视野变形器[4]编码器和一个UperNet[5]解码器,道路损毁评估部分使用一个CRASAR-U-DROIDs数据集培训的注意U-Net架构[6]. 该数据集确保模型具有高度的操作可靠性,因为它包含超过67千兆像素的图像,这些图像由应对机构在联邦宣布的10次灾害中直接收集。

blocks.zh: 图1:CURSE ' 26的遥感单元,集成SUAS图像。

blocks.en:
The CURSE’26 exercise provided a mechanism to explore the
sUAS data-to-decision pipeline, rather than just the veracity of the CLARKE output. It confirmed sUAS and machine learning problems encountered at Debby and Helene [ 2 ] and Hurricane Ian [ 8 ] ,
obtained positive feedback from real users, and identified new challenges and research needs.
CURSE’26 also presented an opportunity for examining whether exercises are realistic tests of sUAS and machine learning for sUAS-acquired imagery.
blocks.zh:
CURSE ' 26号演习提供了一个机制,可以探索:
sUAS数据到决策管道,而不仅仅是CLARKE输出的真实性. 它证实了在Debby和Helene[2]和飓风Ian[8]遇到的SUAS和机器学习问题,
得到了实际用户的积极反馈,并确定了新的挑战和研究需要。
CURSE ' 26还提供了一个机会,以审查对SUAS进行实际测试和对SUAS获得的图像进行机器学习。

blocks.en:
This paper is organized as follows. A brief description of
prior work provides background for comparing the exercise to previous research.
Next, a description of the exercise follows, including background aimed at roboticists on how sUAS are situated within the larger data-to-decision process for damage assessment. The lessons learned for building damage assessment are presented, followed by the results from the road damage assessment. Three cross-cutting issues are discussed. The paper concludes with eight findings expected to be of value for the continued responsible innovation of sUAS systems for disaster management.
blocks.zh:
本文编排如下. 简介
以往的工作为将这项工作与以往的研究进行比较提供了背景。
接下来,将介绍这一活动,包括针对机器人学家的关于SUAS如何在损害评估的较大数据与决策过程中的定位的背景。 介绍了建筑损坏评估的经验教训,随后是道路损坏评估的结果。 讨论了三个贯穿各领域的问题。 该文件最后提出了8项结论,预计这些结论对持续负责任地创新灾害管理系统具有价值。

blocks.en: II Prior Work
blocks.zh: 二. 先前的工作

blocks.en:
The CURSE’26 exercise differs from previously published field research on sUAS for damage assessment in general and CLARKE in particular.
At the time of writing, CLARKE is one of two known operationally deployed sUAS damage assessment systems [ 2 , 9 ] . However, the integration of both systems into the sUAS data-to-decision process has been ad hoc and applied to only a small number of orthomosaics, with four used by CLARKE in the US [ 2 ] and four from the 2024 Valencia flash flooding in Spain [ 9 ] .
Consequently, the CURSE’26 exercise serves as a testbed offering a larger-scale deployment to systematically evaluate the formal operational pipeline.
blocks.zh:
CURSE的26号演习不同于以前公布的关于SUAS的实地研究,用于一般损害评估,特别是CLARKE。
在编写本报告时,CLARKE是已知的两个实际部署的SUAS损害评估系统之一[2,9]. 然而,将这两个系统整合到SUAS的数据对决定过程是临时性的,只适用于少数的正统现象,其中四个被CLARKE在美国使用[2],四个来自2024年西班牙巴伦西亚闪电洪灾[9].
因此,CURSE ' 26演习是一个试验台,可以进行更大规模的部署,有系统地评价正式的作业管道。

blocks.en: II-A Automated Damage Assessment
blocks.zh: 二. 自动损失评估

blocks.en: The research community predominantly assumes a seamless data-to-decision pipeline heavily reliant on wireless connectivity and cloud computing infrastructure [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . However, operational deployments have repeatedly demonstrated that wireless connectivity in post-disaster environments is either severely degraded or entirely unavailable, creating a critical bottleneck [ 8 , 2 , 1 ] . For instance, during the response to Hurricane Ian, the massive volume of high-resolution sUAS data generated in bursts by field teams consistently overwhelmed available cellular and satellite uplinks, forcing data managers to physically transport hard drives to intact emergency operations centers [ 8 , 13 ] . Because existing ML frameworks fail to account for these bandwidth constraints, an exercise such as CURSE’26 can highlight the distinct gap in understanding how to effectively execute inference at the edge during an active deployment.
blocks.zh: 研究界主要假定一个完全无缝的数据对决定管道,严重依赖无线连接和云计算基础设施[10、11、12]。 但是,业务部署一再表明,灾后环境中的无线连接要么严重退化,要么完全无法使用,造成了一个关键的瓶颈[8、2、1]。 例如,在应对 " 伊恩 " 飓风期间,实地小组连续生成的大量高分辨率SUAS数据不断压垮现有的蜂窝和卫星上行链路,迫使数据管理人员将硬盘实际运送到完好无损的紧急行动中心[8、13]。 由于现有的ML框架没有考虑到这些带宽限制,如CURSE ' 26这样的演练可以突出在理解如何在主动部署期间在边缘有效进行推论方面存在的明显差距.

blocks.en: II-B CLARKE
blocks.zh: II -B CLARKE (英语).

blocks.en: Previous efforts with processing sUAS imagery and developing and deploying CLARKE identified four issues: testing with a small set of never-before-seen orthomosaics [ 2 ] , transfer to new geographical locations [ 2 ] , wireless bandwidth limitations [ 8 ] , and pilot error [ 14 , 8 ] . The deployments of CLARKE enabled evaluation of the first three, with pilot error out of the scope for feasible data collection.
blocks.zh: 以往处理SUAS图像以及开发和部署CLARKE的努力确定了四个问题:用一小组从未见过的矫形术进行测试[2],转移到新的地理位置[2],无线带宽限制[8],以及飞行员错误[14,8]。 CLARKE的部署使得能够对前三个项目进行评价,试点错误超出了可行的数据收集范围。

blocks.en:
The BDA and RDA classifiers that comprise the machine learning element were described in [ 2 , 1 ] ,
along with how they were used at Hurricanes Debby and Helene [ 2 ] .
Those works show that
CLARKE has been tested for only a small set of never-before-seen orthomosaics (4) at Debby and Helene [ 2 ] .
Further, CLARKE showed weak transfer performance on imagery from Pennsylvania, where Hurricane Debby degenerated into its post-tropical remnants. This is
most likely due to the differences between the rural mountains of Pennsylvania and the flat coastal regions where hurricanes and tropical storms normally occur. The CRASAR-U-DROIDs dataset does not contain mountainous regions.
Wireless bandwidth limitations that the sUAS pilots encountered with the data-to-decision process during the response to Hurricane Ian (2022) were discussed in [ 8 ] , where an expert manually classified the images. The CURSE’26 normative workflow is a codification of the Ian workflow, where CLARKE replaces the expert, so concerns about wireless limitations are still valid.
blocks.zh:
构成机器学习要素的BDA和RDA分类法在[2, 1]中作了描述,
以及飓风德比和海伦的运用方式
这些作品显示
CLARKE在Debby和Helene[2]的测试中只测试了一小组从未见识过的矫形动物(4).
此外,CLARKE在来自宾夕法尼亚州的图像上表现出弱的转移性能,那里的飓风德比退化成其热带后遗迹. 这是
很可能是由于宾夕法尼亚州农村山区和平坦的沿海地区之间的差异,飓风和热带风暴通常都发生在这些地区。 CRASAR-U-DROIDs数据集不包括山区。
SUAS飞行员在应对飓风伊恩(2022年)期间遇到的数据对决定过程中遇到的无线带宽限制在[8]中讨论,一位专家手动将图像分类. CURSE的26个规范工作流程是伊恩工作流程的编纂,CLARKE取代专家,因此对无线限制的担忧仍然有效.

blocks.en: III-A Pipeline from sUAS to Emergency Managers
blocks.zh: 三-A 从SUAS到应急管理人员的管道

blocks.en: Fig. 2: The sUAS to emergency manager pipeline. The pipeline takes sUAS imagery and spatial data that are provided as input to the CLARKE system, providing DA for buildings and roads in the form of data products, which are reviewed by trained personnel and uploaded to a shared location for emergency managers.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2: SUAS呼叫应急管理管道. 管道采用作为CLARKE系统输入的SUAS图像和空间数据,以数据产品的形式为建筑物和道路提供DA,这些数据由经过培训的人员审查,并上载到应急管理人员共用地点。

blocks.en: The pipeline diagram in Fig. 2 illustrates the workflow that CURSE’26 participants were trained on in generating actionable damage assessment information from sUAS imagery. It is a formalization of the process used at Debby and Helene.
blocks.zh: 图2的管道图说明了CURSE的26名参与者在从SUAS图像生成可采取行动的损害评估信息方面接受了培训。 这是Debby和Helene使用的程序的正式化。

blocks.en:
Steps 1-3 are actions taken by the sUAS team. The team conducts an aerial survey, collecting raw imagery from a nadir perspective at a flight altitude determined by the pilot. The teams then create an orthomosaic map from the images using PIX4Dreact, a lightweight software package that can produce an orthomosaic reliably on a consumer laptop [ 15 ] . Other programs could be used, but PIX4Dreact has become the standard of practice because of cost, speed, and reliability.
In step 4, the orthomosaics are uploaded by the teams to the data manager, either via wireless from the field or by transporting an external drive or SD card to the nearest base of operations, and are passed with the building polygons and road lines to the model for inference.
blocks.zh:
步骤1-3是SUAS小组采取的行动。 该小组进行空中勘测,从纳迪尔角度收集飞行员确定的飞行高度的原始图像。 团队随后使用PIX4Dreact从图像中创建了整形图,这个轻量级软件包可以可靠地在消费型笔记本电脑上产生整形[15]. 其他程序可以使用,但由于成本,速度,可靠性,PIX4Dreact已经成为实践的标准.
在第四步中,整形术由队伍通过现场的无线或者通过将外部驱动器或SD卡运送到最近的操作基础上传到数据管理器,并随建筑多边形和道路线一起传递到模型中进行推断.

blocks.en:
Steps 5-8 are where the data manager, one of the authors, applies the machine learning model to infer the damage categories of buildings and roads. The data manager does not know the sUAS or any details of the flights; they work only with the data. To reduce computational effort, the labeled damage is restricted to known building polygons and known roads. The pipeline uses Microsoft’s US Building Footprints [ 16 ] for buildings and OpenStreetMap [ 17 ] roads, as they are commonly used in emergency management, are comprehensive, and are publicly available. If locally sourced building and road polygons are available, they could be readily leveraged as well.
The output of step 5 is labeled buildings and roads. In order to accommodate the multiple possible uses and concurrent users, the output in step 6 is packaged into different outputs (e.g., a GIS-compatible file, a .png suitable for visual inspection, a spreadsheet of building addresses and damage, a map showing road conditions, etc.).
blocks.zh:
步骤5-8是数据管理者(作者之一)应用机器学习模型推断建筑物和道路受损类别的地方. 数据管理者不知道SUAS或飞行的任何细节;他们只使用数据。 为了减少计算工作,标注的损坏仅限于已知的建筑多边形和已知的道路. 管道使用微软的美国建筑脚印[16]用于建筑物和OpenStreetMap[17]道路,因为这些道路通常用于应急管理,是全面的,并且是公开的。 如果有当地来源的建筑和道路多边形,也可以随时加以利用。
第5步的输出为标有标签的建筑物和道路. 为了适应多种可能的用途和同时使用的用户,第6步中的输出被包装成不同的输出(例如,一个与GIS兼容的文件,一个适合视觉检查的.png,一个建筑物地址和损坏的电子表格,一个显示路况的地图等).

blocks.en:
In step 7, the results are examined by the data manager for correctness before being distributed to emergency managers. This examination is necessary for two reasons.
The first reason is, as described in [ 18 ] , that ground maps and sUAS-generated maps have GPS errors, often leading to spatial misalignment of polygons and road lines. The CLARKE system does not correct the spatial misalignment of building polygons or roads. Fortunately, manual alignment, while not ideal in terms of speed and workforce, can be applied to both. The second reason is
transfer of the ML model to new geographical locations and settings, or encountering new out-of-distribution disasters, as discussed in Sec. II-B .
blocks.zh:
在步骤7中,数据管理员对结果进行审查,以确定是否正确,然后分发给应急管理人员。 这项检查是出于两个原因。
第一个原因是,如[18]所述,地面地图和SUAS生成的地图有GPS错误,往往导致多边形和道路线的空间错位. CLARKE系统没有纠正建筑多边形或道路的空间错位. 幸运的是,人工对接虽然在速度和劳动力方面并不理想,但可以适用于两者. 第二个原因是
如第II-B节所述,将ML模式转移到新的地理位置和场合,或遇到新的分配外灾害。

blocks.en: Finally, the workflow finishes with step 8, which sends the data products to the emergency managers at the RSC. Neither the sUAS teams nor the data manager usually has any direct interaction with the emergency managers or each other; all three groups are working in silos. The emergency managers, as data consumers, expect the data products to be correct within their expectations.
blocks.zh: 最后,工作流程以第8步完成,该步骤将数据产品发送给RSC的应急管理人员. 无论是SUAS团队还是数据管理者,通常都与应急管理者或相互之间没有任何直接的交互作用;这三组都是在筒仓里工作的. 应急管理人员作为数据消费者,期望数据产品在其预期范围内正确无误.

blocks.en:
The differences between the nine orthomosaics and those generated at Debby and Helene are: • Geographic diversity. Seven of the nine missions were conducted at different sites in Florida, with the remaining two in Missouri. This replicates the geographical diversity experienced at Debby, which spanned Florida and Pennsylvania. • Scale. The average orthomosaic at CURSE’26 covered 0.354 km 2 , half the size of the average orthomosaic at Debby and Helene, which was
0.792 km 2 [ 2 ] .
The CURSE’26 orthomosaics were also smaller than the average of 1.307 km 2 collected at Hurricane Ian [ 7 ] , the largest known deployment of sUAS at a disaster [ 8 , 13 ] . As indicated by the number of buildings, the mission locations ranged from rural (0 buildings in mission 3) to high-density urban (149 buildings in mission 5). The average road length was 5.61 km. • Land use. Because these nine missions were conducted during non-disaster training exercises, they provide a unique opportunity to evaluate the models against new land uses. To avoid any public concern over safety or privacy, CURSE’26 missions were generally tasked to fly over industrial parks, urban facilities, or underpopulated rural areas rather than targeting residential neighborhoods, which were a high priority during Debby and Helene. • Types of damage. The missions also provide a unique opportunity to evaluate the models against a near-zero damage baseline.
A manual assessment of all captured imagery found only 31 instances of building damage out of 320 buildings, or 9.7% of buildings. For roads, the baseline physical road damage was estimated to be ≈ 5 % \approx 5\% , primarily due to roads obscured by vegetation and construction.
blocks.zh:
9个整形术与Debby和Helene生成的矫正术的区别是: • 地理多样性. 九次任务中有七次是在佛罗里达州的不同地点进行的,其余两次在密苏里州. 这复制了德比所经历的地域多样性,它横跨佛罗里达州和宾夕法尼亚州. • 规模。 CURSE ' 26的平均矫形范围为0.354 km2,是Debby和Helene的平均矫形体大小的一半。
0.792公里 2 [2] (中文(简体) ).
CURSE的26号整形也小于飓风伊恩所收集的1.307公里2的平均值[7],这是已知发生灾害时SUAS部署的最大一次[8,13]. 如建筑物数目所示,特派团地点从农村(特派团3座大楼为0座)到高密度城市(特派团5座大楼为149座)不等。 平均道路长度为5.61公里。 由于这9个特派团是在非灾害训练演习期间进行的,它们为对照新的土地使用情况评价模式提供了独特的机会。 为了避免公众担心安全或隐私,CURSE的26次任务一般是飞越工业园区、城市设施或人口不足的农村地区,而不是针对居民区,这是Debby和Helene期间的高度优先事项。 • 损害类型。 这些特派团还为对照接近零损害基线评估模型提供了一个独特的机会。
对所有捕获的图像进行人工评估后发现,在320座建筑中,只有31座建筑受损,占建筑物的9.7%。 就道路而言,基本有形道路损坏估计为5%左右,主要原因是道路被植被和建筑遮蔽。

blocks.en: Geographic diversity. Seven of the nine missions were conducted at different sites in Florida, with the remaining two in Missouri. This replicates the geographical diversity experienced at Debby, which spanned Florida and Pennsylvania.
blocks.zh: 地理多样性。 九次任务中有七次是在佛罗里达州的不同地点进行的,其余两次在密苏里州. 这复制了德比所经历的地域多样性,它横跨佛罗里达州和宾夕法尼亚州.

blocks.en:
Scale. The average orthomosaic at CURSE’26 covered 0.354 km 2 , half the size of the average orthomosaic at Debby and Helene, which was
0.792 km 2 [ 2 ] .
The CURSE’26 orthomosaics were also smaller than the average of 1.307 km 2 collected at Hurricane Ian [ 7 ] , the largest known deployment of sUAS at a disaster [ 8 , 13 ] . As indicated by the number of buildings, the mission locations ranged from rural (0 buildings in mission 3) to high-density urban (149 buildings in mission 5). The average road length was 5.61 km.
blocks.zh:
规模。 CURSE ' 26的平均矫形范围为0.354 km2,是Debby和Helene的平均矫形体大小的一半。
0.792公里 2 [2] (中文(简体) ).
CURSE的26号整形也小于飓风伊恩所收集的1.307公里2的平均值[7],这是已知发生灾害时SUAS部署的最大一次[8,13]. 如建筑物数目所示,特派团地点从农村(特派团3座大楼为0座)到高密度城市(特派团5座大楼为149座)不等。 平均公路长度为5.61公里.

blocks.en: Land use. Because these nine missions were conducted during non-disaster training exercises, they provide a unique opportunity to evaluate the models against new land uses. To avoid any public concern over safety or privacy, CURSE’26 missions were generally tasked to fly over industrial parks, urban facilities, or underpopulated rural areas rather than targeting residential neighborhoods, which were a high priority during Debby and Helene.
blocks.zh: 土地利用. 由于这9个特派团是在非灾害训练演习期间进行的,它们为对照新的土地使用情况评价模式提供了独特的机会。 为了避免公众担心安全或隐私,CURSE的26次任务一般是飞越工业园区、城市设施或人口不足的农村地区,而不是针对居民区,这是Debby和Helene期间的高度优先事项。

blocks.en:
Types of damage. The missions also provide a unique opportunity to evaluate the models against a near-zero damage baseline.
A manual assessment of all captured imagery found only 31 instances of building damage out of 320 buildings, or 9.7% of buildings. For roads, the baseline physical road damage was estimated to be ≈ 5 % \approx 5\% , primarily due to roads obscured by vegetation and construction.
blocks.zh:
损害类型。 这些特派团还为对照接近零损害基线评估模型提供了一个独特的机会。
对所有捕获的图像进行人工评估后发现,在320座建筑中,只有31座建筑受损,占建筑物的9.7%。 就道路而言,基本有形道路损坏估计为5%左右,主要原因是道路被植被和建筑遮蔽。

blocks.en: Although a direct comparison between the inference times at CURSE’26 listed in Table I and Debby and Helene is not possible, the fast inference time at CURSE’26 is expected to be applicable to deployments using laptop computers. The average inference time using a desktop computer with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24 GB) GPU and an Intel Core Ultra 9 285K (3.70 GHz) CPU with 128 GB RAM was 209 seconds (3.5 minutes). Such hardware is reasonably deployable at a base of operations, and even though the CURSE’26 orthomosaics were smaller, it is expected that equivalent inference times can be achieved on laptops with similar NVIDIA GPUs.
blocks.zh: 虽然无法直接比较表一所列CURSE ' 26和Debby和Helene的推断时间,但预计CURSE ' 26的快速推断时间将适用于使用膝上型计算机的部署。 使用一台台式计算机的平均推断时间为209秒(3.5分钟),该计算机配有NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090(24 GB) GPU和Intel Core 9 285K(3.70 GHz) CPU配有128 GB RAM. 这种硬件可以合理地部署在行动基地上,尽管CURSE的26个矫正器较小,但预计在使用类似的NVIDIA GPU的笔记本电脑上可以实现等效的推论时间.

blocks.en: IV Building Damage Assessment
blocks.zh: 四. 建筑物损坏评估

blocks.en: Fig. 3: The confusion matrix for all building damage assessment missions.
blocks.zh: 图3:所有建筑物损坏评估任务的混乱矩阵。

blocks.en:
The Building Damage Assessment (BDA) component functioned well for each of the eight missions that captured buildings, measured in terms of F1, transfer, and lack of need for manual adjustments to correct spatial misalignment. It should be noted that as this event was an exercise, the system was not run on actual disaster imagery, meaning that the system performance on the complete collection of JDS classes could not be evaluated. However, the exercise did highlight three potentially significant failure modes, particularly in
commercial and larger buildings. Of these failure modes, only poor illumination can be mitigated by the sUAS; pilots should try to fly as close to noon as possible, though the operations tempo of a real disaster may not permit this.
blocks.zh:
建筑损坏评估(BDA)构成部分对8个特派团中的每个特派团都运作良好,这些特派团以F1、转移计量,而且不需要人工调整以纠正空间错位。 应当指出,由于这次活动是一次演习,因此该系统没有在实际灾害图像上运行,这意味着无法评价系统在JDS类全集上的性能。 然而,这项工作确实突出了三种潜在的重大失败模式,特别是:
商业和大型建筑。 在这些故障模式中,只有差的照明才能通过SUAS来缓解;飞行员应该尽量在接近中午的时候飞行,尽管真正的灾难的运行节奏可能不允许这样做.

blocks.en: IV-A Performance
blocks.zh: 四A 业绩

blocks.en: While fully evaluating the correctness of model predictions is not possible given the incomplete and otherwise highly unbalanced class distributions, Fig. 3 shows the full confusion matrix and that the performance of the model was acceptable on the CURSE’26 orthomosaics, as it presents a Micro F1 of 0.834. The ground truth labels were collected by the authors who have direct expertise responding to major disasters and curating building damage assessment labels for use in machine learning models [ 7 ] . The reader should note the heavy class imbalance towards the “no damage” class, and that prior work has evaluated these models on CRASAR-U-DROIDs using Macro F1 [ 1 ] . This limited class distribution forces an evaluation using micro-average F1.
blocks.zh: 由于模型的分类分布不全,或者高度不平衡,因此无法充分评价模型预测的正确性,但图3显示的是完全的混淆矩阵,该模型的性能在CURSE的26个整形模型上是可以接受的,因为它呈现的是0.834的微F1. 地面真相标签由拥有应对重大灾害的直接专业知识的作者收集,并整理建筑损坏评估标签,用于机器学习模型[7]. 读者应注意到,在“无损害”类上存在着严重的阶级不平衡,以前的工作曾使用Macro F1[1]对这些模型进行了评价。 这种有限的类分配迫使使用微平均值F1进行评价.

blocks.en:
In addition to the reasonable F1 score, the model showed positive transfer to the orthomosaics from Missouri. Given the amount of hurricane imagery from the state of Florida in the CRASAR-U-DROIDs training set, it was not surprising that the model performed well on the six Florida missions. It was surprising to see that the model transferred to the two Missouri missions, given the different terrain and the problems encountered with the deployment of the model during Hurricane Debby. Though claims of complete transfer cannot be made as this exercise did not permit the evaluation of the model on the complete set of JDS classes, there was no obvious or persistent failure across the imagery. Notably, the most similar data in the CRASAR-U-DROIDs dataset, the 2021 Mayfield, Kentucky, tornado disaster, was included in the test set and was not used for model training.
From a practical workflow aspect, the BDA component did not require any manual adjustments to the spatial alignment of building polygons.
blocks.zh:
除了合理的F1分数外,该型号还显示从密苏里州向矫形体的正转. 鉴于佛罗里达州在CRASAR-U-DROIDs训练集中的飓风图像量很大,该模型在佛罗里达州六次任务中表现良好并不奇怪. 令人惊奇的是,该型号被转移至两个密苏里州任务,因为不同的地形以及该型号在飓风德比期间的部署遇到的问题. 虽然无法提出完全移交的要求,因为这种做法无法对一套完整的联合开发服务系统类别进行模型评价,但整个图像没有明显或持续的故障。 值得注意的是,CRASAR-U-DROIDs数据集中最相似的数据,2021年肯塔基州梅菲尔德,龙卷风灾难,都被纳入测试集,没有用于模型训练.
从实际工作流程方面来看,BDA组件不需要对建筑多边形的空间对齐进行任何人工调整.

blocks.en: IV-B Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 四-B 失败模式

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Three examples of failure modes for the BDA model. [Upper-Left] Example of an incorrect spatial polygon for a building. [Upper-Right] Example of incorrect building damage classification of the left side buildings affected by illumination factors. [Bottom] Example of incorrect building damage classification for a large building (predicted “un-classified” vs. actual label “no damage”). Classes are represented by the following colors: (green, “no damage”), (yellow, “minor damage”), (blue, “un-classified”).
blocks.zh: 费格。 4: BDA模式失败模式的三个实例. [上-左]建筑空间多边形不正确的示例. [上-右]受照明因素影响的左侧建筑损坏分类不正确的例子. [Bottom]大型建筑建筑损坏分类不正确的例子(预计“未分类”与实际标签“无损害”)。 类别以下列颜色(绿色,“无损害”),(黄色,“轻微损害”),(蓝色,“未分类”)为代表。

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 shows three different cases of failures: incorrect building polygons, under-representation of large structures, and illumination issues.
The large apartment complex in the upper left is represented by a single green polygon in Microsoft’s US Building Footprints [ 16 ] . This is a failure of the footprint data, not of the model.
The polygon for the long, narrow manufacturing facility at the bottom is correct, but the model classifies it as “un-classified” despite no obvious damage, possibly because large commercial and multi-unit residential structures are under-represented in the CRASAR-U-DROIDs dataset [ 7 ] .
The upper right image again shows instances where a building is mislabeled as “un-classified” likely due to illumination factors (e.g., shadow casts) affecting the buildings’ visual representations. Those images were taken in early morning or late afternoon rather than the desired midday lighting.
blocks.zh:
图4显示了三个不同的失败案例:建筑多边形不正确,大型结构代表性不足,以及照明问题.
左上方的大型公寓建筑群由微软的美国建筑脚印[16]中的单一绿色多边形代表. 这是脚印数据的失败,而不是模型的失败.
底部长而狭窄的制造设施的多边形是正确的,但该模型将其归类为“未分类的”,尽管没有明显的损害,可能是因为大型商业和多单元住宅结构在CRASAR-U-DROIDs数据集中代表不足[7].
右上方的图像再次显示,由于影响建筑物视觉表现的照明因素(如阴影铸件),建筑物可能被误贴为 " 未分类 " 。 这些图像是在清晨或午后拍摄的,而不是所期望的午间照明。

blocks.en: V Road Damage Assessment
blocks.zh: 五. 道路损坏评估

blocks.en: Based on the qualitative performance during the CURSE’26 exercise, the Road Damage Assessment (RDA) component of the CLARKE system is not ready for operational deployment. It labeled 35.3% of the road length across the nine orthomosaics as damaged against an expected baseline of approximately 5%, with one orthomosaic showing nearly 80% “total damage”. The poor performance of the RDA component appears to be due to three failure modes present in the imagery. These three are discussed in detail below.
blocks.zh: 根据CURSE ' 26演习期间的质量表现,CLARKE系统的道路损坏评估部分尚未准备好投入运行。 它将9个整形体的35.3%的公路长度标为损坏,而预计基线约为5%,其中1个整形体显示“完全损坏”。 RDA组件的性能不佳似乎是由于图像中存在三种故障模式所致. 下文将详细讨论这三个问题。

blocks.en: V-A Performance
blocks.zh: V-A 业绩

blocks.en: TABLE II: Road damage per mission. Note: All missions should have reported 95% or higher values for “no damage”.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:每个任务的道路损坏。 说明: 所有特派团都应报告95%或更高的“无损”值。

blocks.en:
The performance of the RDA component was poor for all orthomosaics.
As shown in Table II ,
the nine orthomosaics contained a total of 50.52 km of roads, ranging from 0.24 to 22.85 km per image. For example, in Table II , the orthomosaic from mission 3 labeled nearly 80% of the roads as “total damage”. None of the missions were labeled with ≈ 95 % \approx 95\% of the roads as “no damage”, as would be expected from the manual inspection of the imagery. Given the obvious disparity between reality and predictions, generating a confusion matrix was not considered necessary.
blocks.zh:
在所有矫形科中,RDA部分的性能很差。
如表二所示,
这九条正统路线共包含50.52公里的道路,每条图像从0.24公里到22.85公里不等. 例如,在表二中,3号飞行任务的整形将近80%的道路称为“完全损坏”。 没有一个代表团像对图像进行人工检查时所预期的那样,将95%左右的道路标为“没有损坏”。 鉴于现实与预测之间的明显差距,不认为需要形成一个混淆矩阵。

blocks.en: V-B Failure Modes
blocks.zh: V- B 失败模式

blocks.en: Fig. 5: Three examples of failure modes for the RDA model. Road damage labels are represented as green (“no damage”), yellow (“partial damage”), and red (“total damage”). [Left] Example of RDA misclassifications due to misaligned, incorrect spatial road lines, and illumination factors. [Upper-Right] Example of failure mode with road medians. [Bottom-Right] Example of RDA misclassifications with dark road color (tar roads).
blocks.zh: 图5:RDA模式的三个故障模式实例. 道路损坏标签为绿色(“无损坏”)、黄色(“部分损坏”)和红色(“总损坏”)。 [left] RDA因错配,空间道路线不正确,以及照明因素导致的错分类实例. [上-右]道路中位数的故障模式示例. [Bottom-Right] RDA错误分类实例 暗路色(tar Road).

blocks.en: Three primary failure modes for the CLARKE RDA component were identified: spatial misalignment, unfavorable illumination and road color (e.g., shadows, tar roads), and environmental obscurations (e.g., trees). Of the three, spatial misalignment appears to have had the most significant impact on mislabeling. Only unfavorable illumination can be addressed by sUAS pilots, favoring flying midday or overcast conditions. Spatial alignment during post-processing could be improved by integrating a dedicated alignment model, following [ 19 ] . The environmental obscurations are a property of the real world and cannot be addressed by pilots or software directly. However, future efforts should be considered to better manage prediction uncertainty when faced with these types of obscurations.
blocks.zh: 确定了CLARKE RDA组件的三种主要故障模式:空间错位,不适宜照明和路色(如阴影,柏油路),以及环境疏漏(如树木). 在这三个国家中,空间错位似乎对错标影响最大。 只有不好的照明才能通过SUAS飞行员来解决,偏好在中午飞行或超播条件. 在[19]之后,可通过整合专用的对齐模式,改进处理后空间对齐。 环境蒙昧是现实世界的财产,不能由飞行员或软件直接解决. 然而,在面对这些类型的蒙昧时,应考虑今后努力更好地管理预测的不确定性。

blocks.en:
The RDA component exhibits a sensitivity to the spatial alignment of road lines, reflecting a vulnerability previously documented in the literature [ 18 ] . Specifically, the underlying training set expects the structural centerline of the spatial road line to rest exactly in the center of the road within the imagery [ 20 ] . However, the operational version of CLARKE routinely encounters non-uniform spatial alignments when utilizing the publicly available a priori road maps (Steps 5 to 8 in Fig. 2 ).
As shown in the upper right panel of Fig. 5 , spatial misalignments, especially with roads with medians, direct the classifier to adjacent off-road terrain, generating false damage labels.
blocks.zh:
RDA部分显示了对道路线空间调整的敏感性,反映了文献中先前记载的脆弱性[18]. 具体来说,基础训练集期望空间道路线的结构中心线在图像内完全停留在道路中心[20]. 然而,CLARKE的操作版本在使用公开的先验路线图(图2中的Steps 5至8)时经常遇到非统一空间对齐.
如图5右上方面板所示,空间错位,尤其是与带中位数的道路错位,引导分类器到相邻的路外地形,产生虚假的损坏标签.

blocks.en: The RDA model also appears sensitive to illumination and road material variations. The left panel of Fig. 5 illustrates a failure mode where shadows from landscaping elements direct the model to falsely predict “total damage” (red) on an intact surface. This effect is also present in the upper-right panel, where a central median with landscaping, coupled with spatial misalignment, leads the model to predict “total damage” (red) and “partial damage” (yellow) throughout the image. Furthermore, the bottom-right panel of Fig. 5 demonstrates the RDA model’s apparent response to dark road surface colors as it predicts “total damage” (red) on an otherwise clear road.
blocks.zh: RDA模型对照明和道路材料的变异也显得敏感. 图5的左面面板显示了一种失败模式,即景观景观元素的阴影引导模型在完好无损的表面错误地预测“完全损坏”(红色)。 这种影响也存在于右上角的面板上,一个具有景观美化的中位数加上空间错位,导致模型在整个图像中预测“完全损坏”(红色)和“部分损坏”(黄色)。 此外,图5的右下方面板显示了RDA模型对暗色路面颜色的明显反应,因为它预示着在本来很清澈的道路上“完全损坏”(红色)。

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The CURSE’26 exercise provides broader insights into the design and deployment of sUAS and artificial intelligence. The first insight is the complex role exercises can play in evaluating data-to-decision systems involving sUAS. The second insight is that even under ideal conditions, edge computing is necessary. The third insight is that sUAS deployments engender ethical concerns for pilots and data managers.
blocks.zh: CURSE的26号演习对SUAS和人工智能的设计和部署提供了更广泛的见解。 第一个见解是,在评估涉及SUAS的数据对决定系统方面可以发挥复杂的作用。 第二个见解是,即使在理想条件下,边缘计算也是必要的. 第三个见解是,飞行安全系统部署给飞行员和数据管理人员带来了道德问题。

blocks.en: VI-A Role of Exercises in Evaluating sUAS and ML
blocks.zh: VI-A 活动在评价统一审计制度和洗钱法方面的作用

blocks.en: CURSE’26 raises the issue of the role of real-world exercises in evaluating sUAS and artificial intelligence systems such as CLARKE for disasters. Are exercises operational tests of the pipeline but not good inference tests, or can they be both? CURSE’26 suggests that exercises are strong tests of the operational pipeline but weak tests of inference on the damage seen to date, although they are a useful source of edge cases that operational data cannot easily supply.
blocks.zh: CURSE ' 26提出了现实世界演习在评价SUAS和人工智能系统(如灾害的CLARKE)方面的作用问题。 试验是管道的操作试验,但不是良好的推论试验,还是两者兼有? CURSE ' 26建议,演习是对作业管道的有力试验,但对迄今所见损害的推论的试验很弱,尽管它们是操作数据难以轻易提供的边缘案例的有用来源。

blocks.en: The exercise was a realistic test of how CLARKE performed as part of the operational workflow, but it was not a realistic test of the ML model. The imagery collected by the sUAS teams was not representative of the types of damage observed by actual sUAS deployments. The CURSE’26 imagery contained no disaster damage, and only 31 of the 320 buildings showed any damage at all. Missions were also often in commercial areas, versus the residential or rural areas typically targeted after an event.
blocks.zh: 该练习是对CLARKE作为业务工作流程的一部分如何表现的现实测试,但并不是对ML模型的现实测试. SUAS小组收集的图像并不代表实际部署的SUAS所观察到的损害类型。 CURSE的26号图像没有发生灾害,320座建筑中只有31座显示有任何损坏。 特派团也往往在商业地区,而住宅或农村地区通常在事件发生后成为目标。

blocks.en:
Even though the exercise was not a good test of the ML model for typical damage, CURSE’26 illustrates how an exercise can be a source for identifying or testing for future conditions. As described in Sec. III-B , the imagery of undamaged commercial or rural areas did not represent the types of buildings, roads, or damage seen to date in real-world disasters.
Consider that the current practice is to send sUAS to a relatively small set of areas where there is expected to be damage based on hazard prediction maps or the emergency managers’ knowledge of the community. As such, an entire orthomosaic with no damage is an important edge case that does not exist in the CRASAR-U-DROIDs dataset, which contains naturalistic disaster damage.
blocks.zh:

认为目前的做法是将SUAS发送到一套相对较小的地区,根据灾害预测图或社区应急管理人员的知识,预计这些地区将受到损害。 因此,一个完整的整形而无损害,是CRASAR-U-DROIDs数据集中不存在的重要边缘案例,其中包含自然灾害损害.

blocks.en: VI-B Need for Edge Computing
blocks.zh: 需要边际计算

blocks.en:
The exercise confirms prior expectations that edge computing of inference rather than reliance on cloud computing is needed to speed up the sUAS-to-decision pipeline.
The pipeline in Fig. 2 suggests three ways the process could be executed faster: faster data acquisition by the sUAS teams (step 1), post-processing (steps 2-7), and upload to a shared location thus enabling human decision-making (step 8). It is not clear that sUAS teams can fly faster, though there may be improvements in assigning missions.
This leaves the steps of getting the imagery to the data manager and then processing it. The generation of orthomosaics is already done on the edge by the sUAS teams using commercial software optimized for speed. The inference time was on the order of 3.5 minutes. However, the upload times for the orthomosaics to the data manager were on the order of 1 hour, consistent with Hurricane Ian, though specific upload times were not recorded.
It should be noted that CURSE’26 was conducted under ideal conditions for communications, as the wireless infrastructure was intact, unlike in a real disaster. Therefore, it is expected that, based on the findings detailed in [ 8 , 13 ] , the biggest gain in decision speed with sUAS imagery is running inference at the edge.

这就留下了将图像拿到数据管理器然后处理的步骤. 整形术的生成已经由SUAS团队在边缘使用为速度优化的商业软件完成. 推断时间为3.5分钟。 然而,整形术上传到数据管理器的时间大约为1小时,与飓风伊恩一致,尽管具体的上传时间没有记录.
应当指出,CURSE ' 26是在理想的通信条件下进行的,因为无线基础设施是完好无损的,不同于一场真正的灾难。 因此,根据[8,13]中详述的研究结果,使用SUAS图像在决策速度上的最大收益是在边缘进行推断。

blocks.en: VI-C Responsible Innovation
blocks.zh: VI-C 负责任的创新

blocks.en: Although CLARKE is autonomous for BDA, it requires human oversight of the data products. Such oversight is needed to ensure that there are no major degradations in accuracy due to different disasters, geographies, or other out-of-distribution situations. The human oversight is not a casual glance at the output; it requires a data manager skilled in machine learning.
blocks.zh: 虽然CLARKE对于BDA是自主的,但它需要人类对数据产品进行监督. 需要进行这种监督,以确保准确性不会因不同的灾害、地理或其他分配外的情况而出现重大退化。 人的监督并不是对产出的随意看;它需要一位精通机器学习的数据管理员.

blocks.en:
It should be noted that applying CLARKE without human oversight may be a form of negligent misrepresentation, because emergency managers form expectations about accuracy that the developers have neither corrected nor restricted, and thus developers may be legally liable for harms [ 21 ] .
The sUAS pilots and data manager should be aware that it is their responsibility to ensure that their outputs are of the highest quality and do not show any of the failure modes in Secs. IV and V because how the damage assessment products will be used and by whom is unknown. As shown in Fig. 2 step 8, the data products are uploaded to a common store in the RSC for access potentially by anyone in the incident command enterprise. If the data products are not within expectations, the decision-maker would not be aware of the problems.
Although running at the edge is desirable, it may not be an easy solution given the current state of automatic classification, the potential for errors to negatively affect the response, and the developers’ legal liability.

blocks.en: VII Findings
blocks.zh: 七、结 论 调查结果

blocks.en:
The examination of the CURSE’26 exercise in the context of previous deployments and research experimentation leads to eight findings. These findings contribute to disaster robotics research and practitioner communities: 1. The use of sUAS with computer vision/machine learning for automated damage assessment is now operationally normalized and accepted. It was incorporated into training 23 sUAS teams from two states at CURSE’26 as standard operating procedures for the upcoming hurricane season. The participants expressed satisfaction with CLARKE outputs. 2. sUAS teams in the field can improve CLARKE automated damage assessment by flying in overcast or midday conditions to minimize shadows. As described in Sec. IV and Sec. V , illumination has a noticeable impact on labeling damage. While the operational tempo of a response may not permit teams to choose when to fly, if they do have a choice, they should strive for the conditions that produce the highest image quality. 3. The use of sUAS with CLARKE for building damage assessment is mature. As described in Sec. IV , CLARKE performed well in terms of F1, transfer, and lack of need for manual adjustments to correct spatial misalignment.
CURSE’26 addressed the issue of being exposed to a small set of
never-before-seen images raised in Sec. II-B . The exercise increased the number of new orthomosaics from 4 to 13.
Although the CURSE’26 orthomosaics were smaller than previous events, the average inference time of 3.5 minutes given in Sec. III is consistent with the 5-7 minute times on the CRASAR-U-DROIDs dataset test set orthomosaics [ 7 ] . 4. CLARKE BDA should perform well in novel geographies. CLARKE demonstrated zero-shot transferability to a novel geography, addressing the second issue raised in Sec. II-B . As described in Sec. IV , CLARKE performed well in terms of F1 score, demonstrating strong positive transfer on the Missouri missions (8 and 9). This geographical generalization is particularly notable because similar Midwestern terrain (specifically the Mayfield, Kentucky, tornado imagery) in the CRASAR-U-DROIDs dataset was not used for training the models but was instead isolated for testing. This indicates that the BDA model can successfully generalize to out-of-distribution terrains, such as Missouri. 5. The use of sUAS with CLARKE for road damage assessment (RDA) is not mature. Unlike the BDA component, the RDA classifier misclassified portions of undamaged roads as having some form of damage; in one case, nearly 80% of the roads were mislabeled. The primary culprit appears to be the model’s high sensitivity to non-uniform spatial alignment errors between the road lines and the orthomosaics. 6. Exercises are good operational tests, but their value in evaluating machine learning is less clear. CURSE’26 introduced imagery with two deviations from what has been collected from actual deployments. The first was the general lack of damage in the imagery, representing an inconsistency with respect to actual disaster imagery. The second was the prevalence of commercial buildings and urban areas. As described in Sec. VI , this means CURSE’26 was not realistic in that it was not consistent with imagery seen in the past, but it could be realistic as the scope of sUAS deployments expands. 7. Edge computing with the sUAS teams is needed to overcome the wireless upload barrier. CURSE’26 confirms the concern over wireless bandwidth raised in Sec. II-B . Although specific quantitative upload times were not recorded during the CURSE’26 exercise, it should be clear from Fig. 2 that transferring the data from the field to a data manager in a base of operations or emergency operations center introduces notable time delays, even for a one-day exercise. 8. The application of sUAS and AI to disaster response merits close attention to the principles of responsible innovation. Technologists must be aware of the ways in which their systems may fail when used for a disaster event and proactively prevent misunderstandings of accuracy or propagation of poor results. Human oversight is absolutely critical, and the introduction of faulty data products into an operational data-to-decision workflow could lead to negligent misrepresentation and induce meaningful harms. Technologists and operators must bear the ethical responsibility to verify model outputs and prevent the propagation of failures during operations.
